retailer.hero_subtitle: Handcut buttons for select yarn shops
retailer.hero_img_alt: Handcut wooden buttons on finished knitwear
retailer.intro_text: KNAPVÆRK makes buttons in solid wood. Each button is cut, shaped and finished by hand in our workshop on Hindsholm.
retailer.sortiment_img_alt: Two toggle types in ebony, flamed maple, oak and walnut
retailer.sortiment_text: The range consists of two toggle types — with one hole and with two holes — in four wood species: ebony, flamed maple, oak and walnut. The surface finish is either hand-polished shellac or linseed oil.
retailer.wholesale_only: All buttons are produced exclusively for retailers. We do not sell to private customers.
retailer.why_text1: No minimum order. Lead time from a few days to one week. Recommended retail price 100 DKK per piece.
retailer.why_text2: Everything is cut by hand, making custom shapes possible — even in very small runs. If your shop has an idea, we will find a solution.
retailer.why_text3: Payment is by invoice, net 14 days. For select shops we offer consignment.
retailer.haandvaerk_img_alt: Hands cutting a wooden button in the workshop
retailer.proevepakke_img_alt: Open cardboard box with 18 handcut wooden buttons
retailer.cta_text1: We will send you a sample pack with 18 buttons — free of charge and without obligation. The pack contains both toggle types in all four wood species, with both surface finishes. All delivered in a KNAPVÆRK cardboard box.
retailer.cta_text2: Write to us at <emailLink>info@knapvaerk.com</emailLink> and we'll send the sample.
